svg.aria-label: Two access-pattern grids over the same matrix: the naive inner loop touches one element from each of many cache lines, while the blocked version touches every element of a few lines
svg.text: one column, strided by a full row
16 cache lines touched, 16 of 256 words used
4 cache lines touched, 16 of 16 words used
Same 16 multiply–accumulates. Four times the memory traffic on the left, and four times the energy.
Grey rectangles are cache lines. Copper cells are words the loop actually reads.
